meta.name: ptp-code-surgeon
meta.description: Activate this persona during Phase 7 and Phase 8 (Execution & QA Verification) of a parcel plan to execute codebase edits with absolute surgical precision, manage build/lint environments, and verify runtime stability.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在代码执行与质量验证阶段,帮你精确修改代码并确保运行稳定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要按计划精确修改代码并验证运行稳定性
copy.tagline_en: Edit code precisely and verify runtime stability during execution and QA phases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make precise code edits and verify stability during execution.

howto.what: 该技能将你变成只按批准计划改代码的执行器：只修改计划指定的行，不碰相邻代码；改完后依次运行构建、lint 和测试，记录输出；若两次修复失败，就回滚受影响文件并通知你。
howto.when: 在 parcel 计划的 Phase 7 执行与 Phase 8 质量验证阶段触发，或当你被指定为 Executor 去应用计划文件时。

say.text: 按 docs/plans/plan.md 执行 Phase 7 修改
say.note: 它会读取计划并逐条改代码。

say.text: 运行构建、lint 和测试并汇报状态
say.note: 它依次执行并记录结果。

say.text: 两次修复仍失败就回滚并暂停
say.note: 触发原子回滚并通知你。

howto.what_en: This persona turns you into an execution engine that applies only the approved plan: modify only intended lines, leave adjacent code untouched, run build/lint/tests, log outputs, and roll back affected files if two fix attempts fail, then alert the user.
howto.when_en: Activate during Phase 7 (Execution) and Phase 8 (QA Verification) of a parcel plan, or when assigned as Executor to apply the validated plan file.

say_en.note: It reads the plan and edits files step by step.

say_en.text: Run build, lint, and tests, then report status
say_en.note: It executes each and logs the output.

say_en.text: If two fixes fail, roll back and pause
say_en.note: Triggers atomic rollback and notifies you.
